analysis.headline: USD/KRW slides to 1,337.9 on 4.3% KOSPI surge and month-end sales; NDF 1,334.0
analysis.summary: USD/KRW reversed from 1,347.1 to close down 4.8 KRW at 1,337.9 in Seoul (ECB 1,334.9) as KOSPI surged 4.34% to 4,915.68 with month-end exporter selling. Despite DXY rising to 104.04, 1M NDF finished lower at 1,334.0.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW drops to 1,462.7 as DXY rebound to 104.04 weighs on euro
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW declined to 1,462.7 (ECB ref 1,462.65). With DXY rebounding to 104.04 after Thanksgiving and French fiscal spreads lingering, EUR/USD slipped to 1.0934 while a sharper Seoul USD/KRW drop to 1,337.9 weighed on the cross.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW falls to 836.7 per 100 JPY as yen nears 159.6 despite 2.9% Tokyo CPI
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW fell to 836.7 per 100 JPY (ECB ref 8.367). Tokyo core CPI accelerated to 2.9%, keeping December BoJ hike bets alive, but US-Japan yield gaps pushed USD/JPY up to 159.57 while won strength to 1,337.9 deepened the cross drop.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW eases to 1,751.6 despite sterling defending 1.310 handle
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW dropped to 1,751.6 (ECB ref 1,751.59). Sterling held relatively resilient near 1.310–1.312 on steady BoE rate expectations, yet a 4.3% KOSPI surge and exporter selling drove USD/KRW down to 1,337.9, pulling the cross lower.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW slips to 200.6 as won rally outweighs firmer 6.7075 PBOC fix
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW fell to around 200.6 (ECB ref 200.60). Although the PBOC nudged the USD/CNY fix firmer to 6.7075 and offshore yuan (CNH) held steady near 6.65–6.66, Seoul USD/KRW sliding to 1,337.9 (NDF 1,334.0) pulled the cross lower.

AUD.headline: AUD eases to 890.2 KRW as won strength offsets rebound toward 0.667
AUD.brief: Aussie bounced toward 0.663–0.667 on firmer risk appetite and precious metals, but won strength to 1,337.9 edged AUD/KRW down to 890.2.

CAD.headline: CAD slips to 937.1 KRW as won rally outweighs WTI crude topping $85
CAD.brief: WTI crude jumped 1.7% past $85/bbl to steady USD/CAD near 1.423, yet Seoul USD/KRW dropping to 1,337.9 pulled CAD/KRW down to 937.1.

CHF.headline: CHF drops to 1,597.3 KRW as NY risk-on mood eases safe-haven demand
CHF.brief: Swiss franc fell to 1,597.3 KRW as firmer US equities lifted USD/CHF toward 0.834–0.836 while the won rallied in Seoul.

CNY.headline: CNY slips to 200.6 KRW as won surge outweighs 6.7075 PBOC fix
CNY.brief: Yuan eased to 200.6 KRW as Seoul USD/KRW sliding to 1,337.9 outweighed a firmer 6.7075 PBOC fix and steady CNH near 6.65–6.66.

EUR.headline: EUR falls to 1,462.7 KRW as DXY rebound to 104.04 weighs on 1.0934
EUR.brief: Euro declined to 1,462.7 KRW as DXY rebounded to 104.04 and French fiscal worries pushed EUR/USD to 1.0934 alongside a stronger won.

GBP.headline: GBP eases to 1,751.6 KRW despite sterling holding steady near 1.310
GBP.brief: Sterling dipped to 1,751.6 KRW as Seoul USD/KRW tumbled to 1,337.9, outweighing resilient GBP/USD trade around 1.310–1.312.

HKD.headline: HKD falls to 170.5 KRW tracking Seoul USD/KRW drop to 1,337.9
HKD.brief: Anchored near 7.83 inside its USD peg band, HKD declined to 170.5 KRW in step with USD/KRW falling 4.8 KRW in Seoul.

JPY.headline: JPY drops to 836.7 KRW per 100 JPY as USD/JPY nears 159.6
JPY.brief: Despite 2.9% Tokyo core CPI, rate gaps lifted USD/JPY to 159.57 while won strength pulled JPY/KRW down to 836.7 per 100 JPY.

KRW.headline: KRW rallies to 1,337.9 on 4.3% KOSPI surge & month-end flows; NDF 1,334.0
KRW.brief: Won jumped 4.8 KRW to 1,337.9 as KOSPI surged 4.34% to 4,915.68 on foreign buying and exporter sales; 1M NDF finished at 1,334.0.

USD.headline: DXY rebounds to 104.04 while Seoul closes down at 1,337.9; NDF 1,334.0
USD.brief: DXY climbed 0.33% to 104.04 in NY trade, yet Seoul USD/KRW slid 4.8 KRW to 1,337.9 (NDF 1,334.0) on stock inflows and exporter selling.
